info.about: Pokémon Crystal Version is a role-playing video game developed by Game Freak and published by Nintendo for the Game Boy Color, released in Japan in December 2000 and internationally throughout 2001. Serving as an enhanced edition of the 1999 titles Pokémon Gold and Silver, it is the final entry in the second generation of the Pokémon game series.
info.why: Released in North America in July 2001, weeks after the Game Boy Advance launched, and it was the only second-generation Pokémon game that required a Game Boy Color.
